notes.title: 9.1 Updates
notes.content:
1. Fix bugs
- Fixed so that the helmet you are wearing does not disappear when crafting a gem
- Fixed the cost to appear correctly when forge
- Fixed to enable gold bar crafting
2. Price change
- Forge prices lowered for some items
- Costume Forge cost changed from lyng to topa
3. Removed Essence Crafting

notes.title: Update 8.27
notes.content:

2. Gathering quest level restrictions are lifted.
3. Bug Fix: Impossible to move, crash when receiving rewards.

Monster Attack Modification
Fixed excessively high skill damage of some monsters
